description.zh: 文明演化的结构化规则定义（Phase A：对象清单层）。基于 board-game-ontology v0.1.0。
description.en: Structured rule definition for Civolution (Phase A: object inventory). Based on board-game-ontology v0.1.0.

description.zh: 文明演化中的食物资源，用于喂养阶段喂饱部落。玩家通过狩猎、收入芯片、天气效果等获得。每有一个在营地或船上的部落需要 1 食物，每有一个在营地之外的部落需要 2 食物。
description.en: Food resource in Civolution, used in the Feeding phase to feed tribes. Players gain it through hunting, income chips, weather effects, etc. Each tribe on an encampment or boat requires 1 food; each tribe in the wilderness requires 2 food.

description.zh: 食物的计量单位为「个」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for food: 'marker'.

description.zh: 文明演化中的钱币资源，主要用于交易模组购买材料。玩家通过出售仓库中的材料获得。
description.en: Money resource in Civolution, mainly used by the Trade module to purchase materials. Players gain it by selling stored materials.

description.zh: 钱币的计量单位为「个」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for money: 'marker'.

description.zh: 已运输到<console>仓库中的原材料。是建造聚落/雕像、支付研究牌费用、出售换钱的资源。同类型材料完全等价。共 18 种，按产出领地分 6 列、按稀有度分 3 行。
description.en: Raw materials that have been transported to the storage spaces on a <console>. Used to build settlements/statues, pay research card costs, or sell for money. Same-type materials are equivalent. 18 types total, arranged in 6 columns (by territory) × 3 rows (by rarity).

description.zh: 产出此材料的领地类型。只能从对应领地的生产行动中获得。
description.en: The territory type that produces this material. Only obtainable from the corresponding territory via the Production action.

description.zh: 出售时 1 个材料能换多少个钱币。
description.en: How many money markers 1 material yields when sold.

description.zh: 幸运收获时，命运骰需掷出的点数范围。
description.en: The fate die result range needed for Lucky Harvest.

description.zh: 森林产出的基础材料。
description.en: Basic material from forests.

description.zh: 草原产出的基础材料。
description.en: Basic material from grasslands.

description.en: Rare material from forests.

description.zh: Civolution 中最核心的抽象物理零件。高度不到一厘米的八角柱形小木块，每位玩家一种颜色，每人 50 个（共 200 个）。同一个八角柱放在不同区域代表完全不同的概念——放在食物格上代表食物，放在仓库区代表材料，放在特征格上代表特征标记，放在创意格上代表创意标记。颜色本身不决定八角柱代表什么——它所在的位置（zone）才是决定因素。注意：每位玩家的供应上限为 50 个，耗尽时可将<console>或大陆上的标记退回供应堆（但雕像、重置标记和船上的标记除外）。
description.en: The most central abstract physical piece in Civolution. A tiny octagonal pillar less than 1cm tall, one color per player, 50 per player (200 total). The same pillar represents entirely different concepts depending on where it is placed — on a food space it represents food, in the storage area it represents a material, on a feature space it represents a feature marker, on the idea space it represents an idea marker. The color itself does not determine what the pillar represents — its location (zone) is the deciding factor. Note: each player's supply is limited to 50. When exhausted, markers may be returned from the <console> or continent to the supply (except statues, reset markers, and markers on boats).

objects.appearance: 高度不到一厘米的小木块，截面为正八边形。每位玩家一种颜色，每人 50 个，共 200 个。

description.zh: Civolution 中用于轨道标记的物理零件。外形像纽扣电池——扁圆柱体，一面中央凸起一块，另一面中央凹陷下去。多个同色圆片可以通过凸起嵌入上一个圆片的凹洞而稳固叠放，适合在计分轨、进程轨等需要堆叠标记的场景中使用。每位玩家有自己的颜色。
description.en: A physical piece used for track markers in Civolution. Shaped like a button cell battery — a flat cylinder with a central bump on one side and a central indentation on the other. Multiple discs of the same color stack securely by fitting each bump into the indentation of the disc above, ideal for score tracks, progress tracks, and other stacking scenarios. Each player has their own color.

objects.appearance: 纽扣电池形扁圆柱体，一面中央凸起，另一面中央凹陷。多片可互相嵌合叠放。每位玩家 7 个（1 分轨 + 1 阿格拉恩惠轨 + 5 进程轨），共 28 个。

description.zh: 放置在 <continent> 区域或船上的未运输材料标记。它代表某种材料但尚未进入玩家仓库，需要通过运输才能变成 <stored_material>。
description.en: A material marker placed on a <continent> region or boat, not yet transported to storage. It represents a material but is not yet in the player's storage; must be transported to become a <stored_material>.

description.zh: 此标记最终将运输为哪一种 <stored_material>，由所在区域的材料板块决定。
description.en: Which <stored_material> this marker will become when transported, determined by the material tile of its region.

description.zh: 放置在<console>特征格上的标记，代表玩家拥有的某种特征。特征用于满足研究牌费用、获取属性芯片、时代计分等。
description.en: A marker placed on a feature space of a <console>, representing a feature the player has. Features are used to satisfy research card costs, acquire attribute chips, and score in the Evolution category.

description.zh: 特征类型：耐力、智慧、镇定、灵巧、表达、观察。
description.en: Feature types: Stamina, Intelligence, Calm, Dexterity, Expression, Perception.

description.zh: 代表玩家文明在 <continent> 上存在的核心 <ontology::piece>。每个部落有两种状态：站立（strong）和躺倒（weak）。只有站立部落可以迁徙；躺倒部落在喂养阶段若未被喂饱会死亡。
description.en: The core <ontology::piece> representing a player's civilization on the <continent>. Each tribe has two states: strong (upright) and weak (lying). Only strong tribes can migrate; weak tribes die in the Feeding phase if not fed.

description.zh: 部落的姿态。upright = 站立（健康），lying = 躺倒（虚弱）。
description.en: The tribe's posture. upright = standing (healthy), lying = lying down (weak).

description.zh: 玩家颜色的米宝形木质指示物。站立放置表示 strong 状态，躺倒放置表示 weak 状态。
description.en: A meeple-shaped wooden marker in the player's color. Upright placement indicates strong state; lying placement indicates weak state.

description.zh: 玩家建造在建造点上的大型建筑 <ontology::piece>。每位玩家最多建造 4 个聚落。建造后获得收入芯片并立即执行，建造第 4 个时可激活层级四或层级五板块。
description.en: A large building <ontology::piece> built by a player on a Building ground. Each player can build at most 4 settlements. Building one grants an income chip and executes it immediately; building the 4th allows flipping a stage-4 or stage-5 tile to active.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的小房屋造型木质建筑件，放置后不能再主动移除。
description.en: A small house-shaped wooden building piece in the player's color; cannot be voluntarily removed after placement.

description.zh: 玩家建造在陆地区域的农业建筑 <ontology::piece>。每位玩家最多建造 3 个农场。农场可减少同区域部落在喂养阶段的食物消耗，且建造后获得一个创意标记。
description.en: An agricultural building <ontology::piece> built by a player on a land territory. Each player can build at most 3 farms. A farm reduces the food cost for tribes in the same territory during the Feeding phase, and building one grants 1 idea marker.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 喂养阶段计算食物需求时
<ontology::condition>.en: When calculating food requirements during the Feeding phase

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 与此农场同一区域内的营地部落自动视为已喂饱（消耗 0 食物），野外部落仅需 1 食物（无农场时需 2 食物）。每个陆地区域最多一个农场，效果不叠加。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: Tribes on encampments in the same territory as this farm are auto-fed (0 food); tribes in the wilderness of that territory require only 1 food (instead of 2 without a farm). Each land territory can have at most one farm; effects do not stack.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的小农场造型建筑件。火山相邻区域不能建造农场。
description.en: A small farm-shaped building piece in the player's color. Cannot be built in territories adjacent to a Volcano.

description.zh: 玩家建造在水域区域的 <ontology::piece>。每艘船最多容纳 2 个同玩家部落和 1 个原材料标记，并提供在水域区域进行迁徙、生产、狩猎等活动的能力。每位玩家最多建造 2 艘船。
description.en: A <ontology::piece> built by a player on a Water territory. Each boat can hold up to 2 tribes and 1 raw material marker of the same player, and enables migration, production, hunting, etc. on Water territories. Each player can build at most 2 boats.

description.zh: 船上可容纳部落的区域，最多 2 个同玩家<tribe>。
description.en: A zone on the boat that can hold up to 2 <tribe>s of the same player.

description.zh: 船中央的凹槽，可放置 1 个<raw_material>标记。
description.en: A notch in the center of the boat for holding 1 <raw_material> marker.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的小船造型建筑件，中央有凹槽放置材料标记。
description.en: A small boat-shaped building piece in the player's color, with a central notch for holding a raw material marker.

description.zh: 用通用标记放置在建造点上的建筑标记。建造后推进任意进程轨 1 格，并在之后的每个收入阶段按 <favor_of_ager_track> 位置计分。每位玩家在每个建造点可建 1 个聚落加 1 个雕像，或 2 个雕像。
description.en: A building marker placed on a Building ground using a generic marker. Building one advances any progress track by 1 step, and each statue scores in subsequent Income phases based on the Favor of Agera track position. Each player may build 1 settlement + 1 statue or 2 statues per Building ground.

description.zh: 玩家可激活的模组。本质是一个 <ontology::effect>——激活是 payer action，支付两颗白骰子是 cost，模组做的事是 content。22 个模组：15 个<upgradable_module>（可升级，3 等级效果内联在实例中）、6 个特征模组、1 个睡眠模组。升级由 <upgrade_main_module>（specifies <ontology::upgrade>）驱动：L1→L2 tile 翻面，L2→L3 tile 放回游戏盒、L3 effect 激活。
description.en: An activatable module. Fundamentally an <ontology::effect> — activation is a player action, paying 2 activation dice is the cost, and what the module does is the content. 22 modules: 15 <upgradable_module>s (upgradable, 3 level effects inlined in the instance), 6 feature modules, 1 sleep module. Upgrading is driven by <upgrade_main_module> (specifies <ontology::upgrade>): L1→L2 flips the tile, L2→L3 returns the tile to the game box and activates the L3 effect.

description.zh: 等级一、二时为矩形 cardboard 板块，正面印有费用点数和行动图标，背面为升级效果。等级三时印在<console>模组槽底部，不可移动。
description.en: At levels 1-2: a rectangular cardboard tile printed with activation costs and action icons, with the upgraded effect on the back. At level 3: printed directly on the <console> module slot, unmovable.

description.zh: 模组类型：主模组（可升级）、特征模组、睡眠模组。
description.en: Module type: main (upgradable), feature, or sleep.

position.en: bottom-left corner

description.zh: 激活此模组所需的第一个<activation_die>点数。
description.en: The first <activation_die> value required to activate this module.

position.en: bottom-right corner

description.zh: 激活此模组所需的第二个<activation_die>点数。
description.en: The second <activation_die> value required to activate this module.

position.en: center

description.zh: 模组激活后执行的效果。
description.en: The effect executed when this module is activated.

description.zh: 可升级的模组效果。激活费用（<ontology::cost>）定义在模组实例顶层，与 <level_effects> 同级；<level_effects> 中每项是一个完整的 <ontology::instant_effect>——各等级费用相同时，其 cost 写 `"this.<ontology::cost>"` 引用顶层定义；若某等级费用不同，直接在该等级的 effect 中写具体 cost。L1 由 tile 正面承载，L2 由 tile 反面承载，L3 印于 <console> 模组槽底部。升级由 <upgrade_main_module>（specifies <ontology::upgrade>，level 状态变更）驱动：L1→L2 翻面，L2→L3 tile 放回游戏盒、L3 effect 激活。
description.en: An upgradable module effect. Activation cost (<ontology::cost>) is defined at the module instance top level, alongside <level_effects>; each entry in <level_effects> is a complete <ontology::instant_effect> — when all levels share the same cost, its cost is written as `"this.<ontology::cost>"` to reference the top-level definition; if a level differs, write the concrete cost in that level's effect. L1 is carried by the tile front, L2 by the tile back, and L3 is printed at the bottom of the <console> module slot. Upgrading is driven by <upgrade_main_module> (specifies <ontology::upgrade>, a level state change): L1→L2 flips the tile, L2→L3 returns the tile to the game box and activates the L3 effect.

description.zh: 模组当前等级，初始为 1。升级 = 此属性从 A 变为 B 的 <ontology::state_change>（specifies <ontology::upgrade>）：subject=本模组，attribute=level，from=当前等级，to=下一等级。物理后果（tile 翻面 / 放回游戏盒）由 <upgrade_main_module> 表达。
description.en: The module's current level, starting at 1. Upgrading is a <ontology::state_change> of this attribute from A to B (specifies <ontology::upgrade>): subject=this module, attribute=level, from=current level, to=next level. Physical consequences (tile flip / return to game box) are expressed by <upgrade_main_module>.

description.zh: 各等级效果列表，按等级升序排列。每项必须包含 `level`（整数）和 `<ontology::instant_effect>`——即该等级完整的激活 effect（cost + content）。费用与顶层相同时写 `"<ontology::cost>": "this.<ontology::cost>"`；不同则直接写具体 cost。
description.en: List of effects per level, ordered by level ascending. Each entry must have `level` (integer) and `<ontology::instant_effect>` — the complete activation effect for that level (cost + content). When the cost matches the top-level one, write `"<ontology::cost>": "this.<ontology::cost>"`; otherwise write the concrete cost.

description.zh: 等级编号，从 1 开始递增。
description.en: Level number, incrementing from 1.

description.zh: 该等级模组的完整激活 effect（cost + content）。cost 与顶层相同时写 `"<ontology::cost>": "this.<ontology::cost>"` 引用；不同则直接写具体 cost。
description.en: The complete activation effect for this level (cost + content). When cost matches the top-level one, write `"<ontology::cost>": "this.<ontology::cost>"`; otherwise write the concrete cost.

description.zh: 该等级效果的自然语言描述，供 LLM 推理时理解语义，与形式化表达并行不悖。
description.en: Natural-language description of this level's effect, for LLM reasoning; complements the formal structure rather than replacing it.

description.zh: 放置在<console>创意格上的标记，用于修改骰子点数。每消耗 1 个创意标记可将任意一颗<activation_die>或<fate_die>的点数加减 1（1 和 6 相连）。
description.en: A marker placed on a player's idea space, used to modify die values. Spending 1 idea marker increases or decreases the value of any <activation_die> or <fate_die> by 1 (1 and 6 are adjacent).

description.zh: 放置在骰子格上的标记，可替代对应点数的激活骰用于激活模组（见 <ontology::substitution>）。只能替代<activation_die>，不能替代<fate_die>。用作支付时放回供应堆（<ontology::supply>），不进入玩家保留区。
description.en: A marker placed on a dice space, usable in place of an activation die of the matching value when activating a module (see <ontology::substitution>). Can only replace <activation_die>s, not <fate_die>s. When used as payment, the marker is returned to the supply (<ontology::supply>), not to a player holding.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 点数与所需一致（取自对应点数骰格）
<ontology::condition>.en: value matches the required die (taken from the dice space of that value)

description.zh: 特殊的计划标记，可当作任意点数的计划标记使用：需要任意点数的激活骰时，可从焦点格放回供应堆替代之（见 <ontology::substitution>）。
description.en: A special planning marker usable as a planning marker of any value: when an activation die of a specific value is needed, one focus marker can be returned from the focus space to the supply in its place (see <ontology::substitution>).

description.zh: 卡牌正面的名称标签，标识该 <ontology::card> 的身份。通常位于卡牌左上角。
description.en: The name label on the face of an <ontology::card>, identifying the card. Usually located at the top-left corner of the card.

description.zh: 可安装到层级分区的 <ontology::card>。纵向分为三部分：上部能力区（安装后唯一露出）、中部五个费用格、下部即时奖励。共 5 种类型——建造（蓝）、洞悉（黄）、突变（绿）、成就（紫）、发明（棕）——每种类型在层级分区中独占一列。
description.en: A <ontology::card> that can be installed into the stage partition. Vertically divided into three sections: top ability area (the only visible part after installation), middle five cost slots, and bottom instant bonus. Five types — Building (blue), Insight (yellow), Mutation (green), Achievement (purple), Invention (brown) — each type occupies one dedicated <column> in the stage partition.

description.zh: 安装费用。五个费用格，从左到右编号 1~5（空格也占编号）。分两类：支付型——从仓库返还指定类型和数量的储存材料或标记至供应堆；持有型——需持有不少于指定类型和数量的特征标记，或已建造不少于指定数量的聚落。单个费用格内可能有两种可选条件，满足其一即可。空格自动视为已满足。相邻费用格之间可能有包含图标——满足前者时后者自动视为已满足。
description.en: Install cost. Five cost slots, numbered 1-5 left to right (empty slots count). Two types: payment — return specified stored materials or markers from storage to supply; possession — possess at least the specified number of feature markers or have built at least the specified number of settlements. A single slot may contain two alternative conditions. Empty slots are auto-satisfied. Adjacent slots may have an inclusion icon.

position.zh: 上三分之一与下三分之一
position.en: top third and bottom third

description.zh: 安装完成后结算的效果。上部为持续能力（安装后露出，持续可用），下部为即时奖励（安装时一次性触发，带闪电图标，必须结算否则作废）。
description.en: Effects resolved after installation. Top: continuous ability (visible after install, persistently available). Bottom: instant bonus (triggers once on install, lightning icon, must resolve or forfeit).

description.zh: 研究牌类型：建造、洞悉、突变、成就、发明。
description.en: Research card type: Building, Insight, Mutation, Achievement, Invention.

description.zh: 每时代翻开一张的 <ontology::card>，决定本时代天气变化和事件奖励。它携带两个效果（<weather_trend> 与 <event_effect> 两个 part），分两个环节结算：右上角 <weather_trend>（天气效果——事件阶段 A 步据此移动 <weather_indicator>）；下半部分 <event_effect>（事件效果——事件阶段 B 步结算奖励）。
description.en: A <ontology::card> revealed once per era, determining the era's weather change and event effect. It carries two effects (the <weather_trend> and <event_effect> parts), resolved in two steps: the <weather_trend> in the top-right corner (weather effect — moves the <weather_indicator> in step A of the Event phase); the <event_effect> on the lower part (event effect — resolved in step B of the Event phase).

position.en: top-left corner of the event card

description.zh: 此事件牌的名称
description.en: the name of this event card

position.en: top-right corner of the event card

description.zh: 天气效果（事件阶段 A 步结算）——本时代天气标记沿 <weather_gauge> 移动的方向和步数，效果定义见 <weather_trend>
description.en: The weather effect (resolved in step A of the Event phase) — the direction and number of steps the weather marker moves along the <weather_gauge> this era; its effect is defined on <weather_trend>

position.en: lower part of the event card

description.zh: 事件效果（事件阶段 B 步结算）——其 <ontology::condition> 成立时结算 <ontology::content>，效果定义见 <event_effect>
description.en: The event effect (resolved in step B of the Event phase) — when its <ontology::condition> holds, its <ontology::content> is resolved; its effect is defined on <event_effect>

description.zh: <event_card>右上角的天气变化指示器，显示本时代天气标记沿<weather_gauge>移动的方向（向热端或向冷端）和步数。它是事件牌的两个效果之一（天气效果）：事件阶段 A 步结算此效果，据此移动天气标记；事件牌的另一效果（事件奖励）见其 <event_effect> part。
description.en: A weather change indicator at the top-right corner of an <event_card>, showing the direction (toward the hot or cold end) and number of steps the weather marker moves along the <weather_gauge> this era. It is one of the event card's two effects (the weather effect): resolved in step A of the Event phase to move the weather marker; the card's other effect (the event effect) is its <event_effect> part.

<ontology::push_track>.step: 本牌指示的 1 或 2 步（向热端或向冷端）

description.zh: 将 <weather_indicator> 沿 <weather_gauge> 按本牌 <weather_trend> 指示移动 1 或 2 步（变热向热端、变冷向冷端）。白线位于 <hot_beyond> 与 <hot> 之间、<cold_beyond> 与 <cold> 之间：若移动使标记越出白线（目标位置在 <hot> 外侧或 <cold> 外侧），标记停在白线外的越线格（<hot_beyond> 或 <cold_beyond>，越出 2 步也停在该格不继续外移）。
description.en: Move the <weather_indicator> along the <weather_gauge> by the 1 or 2 steps shown by this card's <weather_trend> (toward Hot when warming, toward Cold when cooling). The white lines lie between <hot_beyond> and <hot>, and between <cold_beyond> and <cold>: if the movement takes the indicator over a white line (target position outside <hot> or outside <cold>), it stops on the over-line space (<hot_beyond> or <cold_beyond>; a 2-step overrun still stops there, never beyond).

description.zh: <event_card>下半部分的效果，事件牌的两个效果之一（事件效果）：事件阶段 B 步结算此效果——<ontology::condition> 成立时结算 <ontology::content>。每张牌的条件与内容不同（见实例）。事件牌的另一效果（天气效果）见其 <weather_trend> part。
description.en: The effect on the lower part of an <event_card>, one of the event card's two effects (the event effect): resolved in step B of the Event phase — when its <ontology::condition> holds, its <ontology::content> is resolved. The condition and content vary per card (see the instance). The card's other effect (the weather effect) is its <weather_trend> part.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本事件牌效果的触发条件（每张牌不同，见实例）。
<ontology::condition>.en: This event card's effect condition (varies per card, see the instance).

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 本事件牌的效果内容（每张牌不同，见实例）。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: This event card's effect content (varies per card, see the instance).

description.zh: 设置阶段使用的 <ontology::card>，指示玩家初始可获得的标记（按牌上指示从供应堆取标记放置）。设置完成后放回盒子，不安装。
description.en: A <ontology::card> used during setup indicating which markers a player starts with (markers are taken from supply and placed per the card's indication). Returned to the game box after setup; never installed.

description.zh: 设置阶段使用的 <ontology::card>，记录玩家首个升级的模组和首个收入芯片。上三分之一是一块 <income_chip>。设置过程中，此牌翻开后提供一个临时 zone 用于容纳目标芯片——玩家从目标芯片展示区选取芯片放在此牌上。设置完成后，此牌塞入<console>的收入区成为第一个收入芯片（上三分之一露出，激活收入芯片时可以选择它），其承载的 zone 随之消失。
description.en: A <ontology::card> used during setup indicating the player's first upgraded module and first income chip. Its top third is an <income_chip>. During setup, once revealed, this card provides a temporary zone for holding goal chips — the player selects chips from the goal chip display and places them on this card. After setup, it is slid under the <console> into the income area as the first income chip (the top third is revealed and selectable when activating income chips), and its hosted zone disappears.

position.en: face of this card

description.zh: 设置阶段第 16 步，此牌翻开后提供临时 zone 供玩家放置选取的目标芯片。设置完成后此 zone 随牌一起消失。
description.en: During setup step 16, once revealed, this card provides a temporary zone for placing selected goal chips. This zone disappears with the card after setup.

description.zh: 可安装到 <console> 的白色芯片。安装时效果不触发——仅在收入阶段、天气轨温暖格或进程轨奖励中通过 <activate_income_chip> 选中时结算。收入芯片可安装在任意列。
description.en: A white chip that can be installed in a <console>. Its effect does not trigger on install — it only resolves when selected by <activate_income_chip> during the Income phase, weather gauge Warm slot, or track bonuses. Income chips can be installed in any column.

position.en: face of the chip

description.zh: 被 <activate_income_chip> 选中时结算的效果。具体结构在实例中定义。
description.en: Effect resolved when selected by <activate_income_chip>. Specific structure defined per instance.

description.zh: 正方形的蓝色板块，面积为 <income_chip> 或 <attribute_chip> 的一半。玩家从展示区拿取后安装在 <console> 目标列。安装后可能揭示升级奖励。每叠目标芯片安装完后可升级一个模组。
description.en: A square blue tile, half the size of an <income_chip> or <attribute_chip>. Taken from the display and installed in the goal column of a <console>. Installing one may reveal an upgrade bonus. Completing a stack of goal chips allows upgrading one main module.

position.en: top of the chip

description.zh: 芯片名称。
description.en: Chip name.

position.en: middle of the chip

description.zh: 安装此芯片必须满足的条件。部分芯片需支付费用（<instant_cost>），部分仅需满足状态条件（<continuous_cost>）。
description.en: The cost that must be fulfilled to install this chip. Some chips require payment (<instant_cost>), others only a state condition (<continuous_cost>).

position.en: bottom of the chip

description.zh: 芯片编号。
description.en: Chip number.

description.zh: 黄色的芯片。左侧为安装 cost，右侧为条件 effect。中间属性图标仅视觉提示，不被规则引用。
description.en: A yellow chip. Left: install cost. Right: conditional effect. The attribute icon in the middle is visual only, not referenced by rules.

position.en: top of the chip
left side of the chip
right side of the chip

description.zh: 双面 <ontology::tile>，外观为小型矩形板块，其中一角为弧形角。一面为图标面，印有计分类别图标；另一面为分数面，印有分数。
description.en: A double-sided <ontology::tile>, shaped as a small rectangular tile with one rounded corner. One side is the icon side, printed with a scoring category icon; the other is the point side, printed with a point value.

description.zh: 标识层级 4 或层级 5 是否激活的双面 <ontology::tile>。未激活面朝上时该层级终局不计分；激活面朝上时开放计分。正面为激活面——effect 在终局计分时使该层级计分生效；aid 提示该层级安装研究牌需满足的费用格数量。
description.en: A double-sided <ontology::tile> indicating whether stage 4 or stage 5 is active. Inactive side up: no scoring. Active side up: scoring enabled. The active face contains an effect enabling scoring during final scoring, and an aid showing cost slot requirements.

position.en: active face

<ontology::condition>.zh: 终局计分阶段，且此板块激活面朝上
<ontology::condition>.en: Final scoring phase, and this tile is active face up

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 对应层级每安装一张研究牌或一枚芯片，获得该层级标示的分数。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: Score the indicated points for each research card or chip installed in the corresponding stage.

position.en: active face

description.zh: 提示在对应层级安装研究牌需满足的费用格数量。
description.en: Indicates how many cost slots must be satisfied to install a research card at the corresponding tier.

description.zh: 控制台上层级旁的印刷信息。本质是一个<ontology::continuous_effect>——终局计分阶段每安装一张研究牌或一枚芯片获得该层级标示的分数。层级 1/2/3 始终激活，印于<console>上；层级 4/5 同一逻辑，但印于<stage_tile>激活面。
description.en: Printed information beside stages on the <console>. It is fundamentally a <ontology::continuous_effect> — during final scoring, gain the indicated points for each research card or chip installed in this stage. Stages 1/2/3 are always active and printed on the <console>; stages 4/5 follow the same logic but are printed on the active face of a <stage_tile>.

description.zh: 层级编号。1/2/3 始终激活，4/5 需<stage_tile>翻到激活面。
description.en: Stage number. 1/2/3 are always active; 4/5 require the <stage_tile> active face.

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 此层级每安装一张研究牌或一枚芯片，获得该层级标示的分数。一层的<goal_chip>左右各可装一枚，每枚单独计分。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: Score the indicated points for each research card or chip installed in its stage. A tier fits up to two <goal_chip>s (left and right); each scores individually.

description.zh: 提示在此层级安装研究牌需满足的费用格数量。纯提示，不参与游戏计算。
description.en: Indicates how many cost slots must be satisfied to install a research card at this tier. Pure hint; does not participate in game calculations.

description.zh: 放置在 <continent> 上的特殊 <ontology::tile>，外观为正八边形板块，其中一角为方便手指拿取的弧形角。翻开前背面朝上，通过特定条件翻开后持续生效。共 9 种：建造点、狼谷、冰川、神秘橡树、隐蔽洞窟、圣岩、洞穴、蘑菇谷、火山。建造点带有 <building_slot> 可建造 <settlement> 或 <statue>；其他地点仅有 effect 不带 zone。
description.en: A special <ontology::tile> placed on the <continent>, shaped as a regular octagon with one rounded corner for easy finger pickup. Face down until revealed by a specific condition, then taking lasting effect. Nine types: Building ground, Gorge of the Grimwolves, Glacier, Mystic oak, Hidden grotto, Holy rock, Cave, Mushroom valley, Volcano. Building ground carries a <building_slot> for <settlement> or <statue>; other sites have only an effect without a zone.

description.zh: 翻开此地点时立即获得的分数（标记在正面左上角）。
description.en: Success points gained immediately when this site is revealed (marked in the top-left corner of its front side).

description.zh: 翻开本地点（经由<exploration>翻开）的玩家立即获得 5 分（<score>）。地点阶段结算（共 2 块狼谷，各自独立结算）：与狼谷相邻的<territory>中有本玩家<tribe>的玩家，若<food_space>中有<food>则失去 1 个<food>（<lose_food>）；无食物则豁免。
description.en: The player who reveals this site (via <exploration>) gains 5 success points immediately (<score>). Site phase resolution (2 Gorges exist; each resolves independently): each player who has a <tribe> in a <territory> adjacent to this site and has <food> on <food_space> loses 1 <food> (<lose_food>); players without food are exempt.

<ontology::instant_effect>.target: 翻开本地点（经由<exploration>翻开）的<player>

<ontology::condition>.zh: 地点阶段结算中，且本玩家在与本地点相邻的<territory>中有<tribe>，且<food_space>中有<food>。
<ontology::condition>.en: During the site phase, and this player has a <tribe> in a <territory> adjacent to this site, and has <food> on <food_space>.

description.zh: 翻开本地点（经由<exploration>翻开）的玩家立即获得 4 分（<score>）。地点阶段结算（共 2 块冰川，各自独立结算）：相邻<territory>中有强壮（posture == <upright>）<tribe>的玩家，虚弱（躺倒）其中一个强壮部落（<state_change> posture → <lying>）；弱部落不受影响，无强壮部落则豁免。
description.en: The player who reveals this site (via <exploration>) gains 4 success points immediately (<score>). Site phase resolution (2 Glaciers exist; each resolves independently): each player who has a strong (<upright>) <tribe> in an adjacent <territory> must weaken (lay down) one of those strong tribes (<state_change> posture → <lying>); weak tribes are never affected, and players without strong adjacent tribes are exempt.

<ontology::instant_effect>.target: 翻开本地点（经由<exploration>翻开）的<player>

<ontology::condition>.zh: 地点阶段结算中，且本玩家在与本地点相邻的<territory>中有 posture == <upright> 的<tribe>。
<ontology::condition>.en: During the site phase, and this player has a <tribe> with posture == <upright> in a <territory> adjacent to this site.

<ontology::state_change>.subject: 本玩家在与本地点相邻的<territory>中的 1 个 posture == <upright> 的<tribe>

description.zh: 翻开本地点（经由<exploration>翻开）的玩家立即获得 1 分（<score>）。地点阶段结算（共 3 块神秘橡树，各自独立结算）：对每块橡树，本玩家检查相邻且有自己的<tribe>的区域——每个<terrain_water>/<swamp_territory>/<desert_territory>区域得 2 分，每个<forest_territory>/<grassland_territory>/<hill_territory>/<mountain_territory>区域得 1 分。
description.en: The player who reveals this site (via <exploration>) gains 1 success point immediately (<score>). Site phase resolution (3 Mystic oaks exist; each resolves independently): for each oak, the player checks adjacent areas holding at least one of their <tribe>s — each <terrain_water>/<swamp_territory>/<desert_territory> area scores 2 points and each <forest_territory>/<grassland_territory>/<hill_territory>/<mountain_territory> area scores 1 point.

<ontology::instant_effect>.target: 翻开本地点（经由<exploration>翻开）的<player>

<ontology::condition>.zh: 地点阶段结算中，且本玩家在与本地点相邻的区域中有自己的<tribe>。
<ontology::condition>.en: During the site phase, and this player has one of their <tribe>s in an area adjacent to this site.

<ontology::push_track>.step: 按相邻且有自己的<tribe>的区域计：每个<terrain_water>/<swamp_territory>/<desert_territory>区域 +2，每个<forest_territory>/<grassland_territory>/<hill_territory>/<mountain_territory>区域 +1

description.zh: 位于 <continent> 上的一种 <ontology::zone>，由 <continent_tile> 之间、以及 <continent_tile> 与 <score_track> 拼合后的空位形成，共 24 格。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on the <continent>, formed by the gaps between <continent_tile>s and between <continent_tile>s and the <score_track> after assembly. There are 24 slots in total.

description.zh: 此格最多放置一块 <site>。
description.en: This slot holds at most one <site>.

description.zh: 位于建造点 <site> 上的一个 <ontology::zone>，用于建造 <settlement> 或 <statue>。仅建造点类型的地点板块上有此格。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on a building ground <site> that can hold a <settlement> or <statue>. Only the building ground site has this slot.

description.zh: 此格可以建造一个 <settlement> 或一个 <statue>。
description.en: This slot can hold one <settlement> or one <statue>.

description.zh: 拼成 <continent> 的 <ontology::tile>。正面印有不同的 <territory>、<material_slot>、<encampment>、<fire_encampment>；仅 1×1 板块通过 <ontology::tile> 的 parts 机制额外承担 <site> 逻辑身份（建造点）。
description.en: A <ontology::tile> forming part of the <continent>. The front is printed with different terrain zones, <material_slot>s, and encampment positions; the 1×1 tile instance additionally carries a <site> logical identity (Building Ground) via the <ontology::tile> parts mechanism.

description.zh: 放置在 <material_slot> 上的 <ontology::tile>，决定其所在领地可产出的材料类型。正面朝上时表示该领地已开发，可产出对应材料。
description.en: A <ontology::tile> placed on a <material_slot>, determining what material the territory can produce. When face up, the territory is developed and can produce the corresponding material.

description.zh: 位于 <continent_tile> 上的一个 <ontology::zone>，用于放置一块 <material_tile>。每个陆地区域（非海洋）的领地上各有一个 <material_slot>。放在此格上的 <material_tile> 决定了该领地可产出的材料类型——正面朝上表示该材料已解锁可生产，背面朝上表示尚未开发。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on a <continent_tile> that holds one <material_tile>. Each land territory (non-water) has exactly one <material_slot>. The <material_tile> placed here determines what material type the territory produces — face up means the material is unlocked and can be produced; face down means it is not yet developed.

description.zh: 此格最多放置一块 <material_tile>。
description.en: This slot holds at most one <material_tile>.

description.zh: 深绿色的地形区域（zone）。大陆板块上每片森林就是一个 forest zone，可放置部落、进行狩猎与生产。
description.en: A dark green terrain zone. Each forest area on a continent tile is a forest zone where tribes can be placed for hunting and production.

description.zh: 浅绿色的地形区域（zone）。大陆板块上每片草原就是一个 grassland zone。
description.en: A light green terrain zone. Each grassland area on a continent tile is a grassland zone.

description.zh: 土黄色的地形区域（zone）。大陆板块上每片丘陵就是一个 hills zone。
description.en: A yellowish-brown terrain zone. Each hills area on a continent tile is a hills zone.

description.zh: 紫色的地形区域（zone）。大陆板块上每片沼泽就是一个 swamp zone。
description.en: A purple terrain zone. Each swamp area on a continent tile is a swamp zone.

description.zh: 灰色的地形区域（zone），通常有立体边缘便于识别边界。大陆板块上每片山脉就是一个 mountains zone。
description.en: A gray terrain zone, often with raised edges to identify borders. Each mountains area on a continent tile is a mountains zone.

description.zh: 黄色的地形区域（zone）。大陆板块上每片沙漠就是一个 desert zone。
description.en: A yellow terrain zone. Each desert area on a continent tile is a desert zone.

description.zh: 蓝色的地形区域（zone），代表水域。大陆板块上每片水域就是一个 water zone，可造船、航行。
description.en: A blue terrain zone representing water areas. Each water area on a continent tile is a water zone where boats can be built and sailed.

description.zh: 白色的六面骰子，点数 1-6，用于支付模组激活费用。
description.en: A white six-sided die with values 1-6, used to pay module activation costs.

description.zh: 激活骰为六面骰。
description.en: Activation die has 6 sides.

description.zh: 粉色的六面骰，用于恩惠检定、狩猎、幸运收获等。
description.en: A pink six-sided die used for favor tests, hunting, and lucky finds.

description.zh: 命运骰为六面骰。
description.en: Fate die has 6 sides.

description.zh: 双面正方形指示物，正面为 100 分，背面为阻挡标记。玩家分数每超过 100 时拿取一个；设置时部分需翻面作为阻挡标记覆盖不可用区域。
description.en: A double-sided square token with 100 points on the front and a blocking side on the back. Players take one whenever their score passes 100; some are flipped as blocking tokens during setup.

description.zh: 放置在已狩猎区域上的标记，表示本时代该区域不能再被狩猎。收入阶段结束时全部回收。背面也用作阻挡标记覆盖营地。
description.en: A marker placed on a hunted territory, indicating that territory cannot be hunted again this era. All are returned at the end of the Income phase. The back is also used as a blocking token for encampments.

description.zh: 黄色的六边形（六角形）<ontology::marker>，放置在 <sequence_board> 阶段序列上指示当前阶段。终局计分时移入 <final_scoring_area_hex> 逐格推进。
description.en: A hexagonal yellow <ontology::marker> placed on the phase sequence of the sequence board to indicate the current phase. During final scoring, it moves into the <final_scoring_area_hex> and advances cell by cell.

description.zh: 白色的圆柱形 <marker>，放置在 <sequence_board> 天气轨上指示当前天气。
description.en: A cylindrical white <marker> placed on the weather gauge of the sequence board to indicate the current weather.

description.zh: 放置在 <favor_of_ager_track> 上指示当前恩惠等级的 <marker>。影响恩惠检定、雕像收入和终局计分。
description.en: A <marker> placed on the <favor_of_ager_track> to indicate the current favor level. Affects favor tests, statue income, and final scoring.

description.zh: 文明演化中的 <ontology::starting_player_marker>，标记当前起始玩家。
description.en: The <ontology::starting_player_marker> in Civolution, marking the current starting player.

description.zh: 由 <progress_board>、<sequence_board> 与计分轨区域共同构成的公共游戏版图。它承载公共游戏状态——进程轨、天气轨、展示区等；中央的游戏区域由 <continent>（公共 zone）承载，其中的 <continent_tile>、<site>、<material_tile> 等是游戏零件，不属于公共版图本身。
description.en: The shared game board formed by the progress board, sequence board, and score track area. It carries public game state — progress tracks, weather gauge, display areas, etc. The central play area is held by the <continent> public zone; its <continent_tile>s, <site>s, and <material_tile>s are game components, not part of the public board itself.

position.en: outer frame of the public board

description.zh: 由 4 块外框组件拼接而成的计分轨，环绕大陆区域
description.en: score track assembled from 4 frame pieces, surrounding the continent area

description.zh: 本局游戏中由全部 <continent_tile> 在计分轨外框内部的 5×3 矩形网格中拼接形成的公共游戏区域。setup 时 8 块大陆板块（7 块 2×1 + 1 块 1×1 = 15 格）随机排列铺满此网格。拼合后大陆板块与计分轨外框共同形成 24 个 <site_slot>，每个可放置一块 <site>。此外大陆还承载 <territory>、<encampment>、<material_tile> 以及玩家放置的 <tribe>、<settlement>、<farm>、<boat> 等游戏零件。2/3 人局时会使用阻挡标记覆盖部分不可用营地。
description.en: The public play area formed by all <continent_tile>s arranged in a 5×3 rectangular grid inside the score track frame. During setup, the 8 continent tiles (7 × 2×1 + 1 × 1×1 = 15 cells) are randomly arranged to fill this grid. After assembly, the continent tiles and the score track frame together form 24 <site_slot>s, each holding one <site>. The continent also holds <territory>s, <encampment>s, <material_tile>s, and player-placed components such as <tribe>s, <settlement>s, <farm>s, and <boat>s. In 2/3-player games, blocking tokens cover some unavailable encampments.

description.zh: 大陆区域的网格布局。共 5×3=15 格，setup 时必须被 <continent_tile> 恰好铺满（7×2 + 1×1 = 15）。
description.en: The grid layout of the continent area. 5×3 = 15 cells total, must be exactly filled by <continent_tile>s during setup (7×2 + 1×1 = 15).

description.zh: 大陆区域可存放的游戏零件类型：板块（大陆板块、地点板块、材料板块）、物件（部落、聚落、农场、船）和指示物（原材料、各种标记）。
description.en: Game component types the continent zone can hold: tiles (continent, site, and material tiles), pieces (tribes, settlements, farms, boats), and tokens (raw materials and various markers).

description.zh: <continent> 上的一片具体土地。每个领地由其所在 continent_tile 决定地形（森林/草原/丘陵/沼泽/山脉/沙漠/海洋七种之一），可能有一个或多个营地。领地是生产、狩猎、迁徙、建造等活动的基本单位。即使两块相邻领地为同一地形类型，规则上也视为两个不同的领地。
description.en: A specific plot of land on the <continent>. Each territory has a terrain type (one of seven: Forest/Grassland/Hills/Swamp/Mountains/Desert/Water) determined by its continent tile, and may have one or more encampments. Territories are the basic unit for production, hunting, migration, and building. Even two adjacent territories of the same terrain type count as separate territories.

description.zh: 森林地形领地。产出木头、蜂蜡、油。
description.en: Forest territory. Produces Wood, Beeswax, Oil.

description.zh: 草原地形领地。产出纸莎草、药草、黄金。
description.en: Grassland territory. Produces Papyrus, Herb, Gold.

description.zh: 丘陵地形领地。产出棉花、黏土、硫磺。
description.en: Hill territory. Produces Cotton, Clay, Sulfur.

description.zh: 沼泽地形领地。产出煤、泥炭、焦油。
description.en: Swamp territory. Produces Coal, Peat, Tar.

description.zh: 山脉地形领地。产出石头、铁矿、翡翠。
description.en: Mountain territory. Produces Stone, Iron, Jade.

description.zh: 沙漠地形领地。产出沙子、盐、铜。
description.en: Desert territory. Produces Sand, Salt, Copper.

description.zh: 位于大陆地形区域内的圆形标记位置，用于放置 <tribe>。部分营地带人数标记：带 3 人标记的营地在玩家人数 ≥3 时使用，带 4 人标记的营地仅在 4 人局使用——设置时按玩家人数用阻挡标记覆盖不可用营地（2 人局覆盖 10 个、3 人局覆盖 4 个）。
description.en: A circular marker position within a <territory> used to hold <tribe>s. Some encampments bear player-count marks: encampments marked with a 3 are used in games of 3+ players, those marked with a 4 only in 4-player games — during setup, unusable encampments are covered with blocking tokens per player count (10 in 2p, 4 in 3p).

description.zh: 一种特殊的 <encampment>，上面印有篝火图标。当你的 <tribe> 定居（settle）在此营地上时，立即获得其上印的分数（推进计分轨）。黄色火边标记表示此营地可得分。
description.en: A special <encampment> marked with a campfire icon. When one of your <tribe>s settles on this encampment, you immediately receive the success points depicted on it (advancing your marker on the score track). The yellow fire symbol indicates this encampment grants points.

description.zh: 由 4 块外框组件拼接而成的计分轨。每位玩家各用一个 <score_marker> 在此轨上指示当前分数；分数超过 100 时使用 <hundred_point_token> 表示。
description.en: A score track assembled from 4 frame pieces. Each player uses a <score_marker> on this track to indicate their current score; <hundred_point_token>s are used when scores exceed 100.

description.zh: 此轨存放所有玩家的分数标记。
description.en: This track holds all players' score markers.

description.zh: 放置在 <score_track> 上指示玩家当前分数的标记。每位玩家有 1 个。
description.en: A marker placed on the <score_track> to indicate a player's current score. Each player has 1.

description.en: A shared <ontology::public_board> tracking the current era, current phase, and current weather. It hosts the phase sequence, weather gauge, <favor_of_ager_track>, event card spaces, and era scoring area; shared by all players.

description.en: A reference table printed on the <progress_board> used to look up how much food hunting yields based on terrain and die result. it does not change game state, only provides rule reference.

description.zh: 放置在进程轨上指示玩家当前进程等级的 <marker>。每位玩家有 5 个，分别放在 5 条进程轨上。
description.en: A <marker> placed on a progress track to indicate a player's current progress level. Each player has 5, one on each of the five progress tracks.

description.en: A public <ontology::supply> on the <progress_board> holding <activation_die>s and <fate_die>s. During setup, place (player count + 1) of each die type here (e.g., 3 each for 2p, 4 each for 3p, 5 each for 4p). Some dice spaces bear player-count marks: spaces marked with a 3 are used in games of 3+ players, those marked with a 4 only in 4-player games — marked spaces hold no dice in 2/3-player games. During play, players take dice from here when activating modules or resolving effects.

description.zh: 激活骰与命运骰分别最多存放「玩家人数 + 1」个。
description.en: At most (player count + 1) of each die type.

description.zh: 此区域存放公共的 <activation_die> 和 <fate_die>。
description.en: This zone holds the public <activation_die>s and <fate_die>s.

description.zh: <progress_board> 上的公共 <ontology::supply>，存放 <hunting_token>。设置时部分标记需翻面作为阻挡标记覆盖营地，其余作为供应堆。
description.en: A public <ontology::supply> on the <progress_board> holding <hunting_token>s. Some tokens are flipped as blocking tokens to cover encampments during setup; the rest form the supply.

description.zh: <progress_board> 上的公共 <ontology::supply>，存放 <hundred_point_token>。
description.en: A public <ontology::supply> on the <progress_board> holding <hundred_point_token>s.

description.zh: <progress_board> 上的 <ontology::market>，正面朝上展示可拿取的 <goal_chip>。共 6 格，其中部分格带人数标记：1 格带 3 人标记（玩家人数 ≥3 时使用）、1 格带 4 人标记（仅 4 人局使用），其余 4 格无标记。设置时按玩家人数覆盖不可用格并各放 1 张：4 人局 6 张、3 人局 5 张、2 人局 4 张。
description.en: A <ontology::market> on the <progress_board> displaying available <goal_chip>s face up. 6 spaces total, some bearing player-count marks: 1 space marked with a 3 (used in games of 3+ players) and 1 marked with a 4 (4-player games only); the other 4 spaces are unmarked. During setup, unusable spaces are covered per player count and 1 chip is placed on each used space: 6 for 4p, 5 for 3p, 4 for 2p.

description.zh: 此区域存放正面朝上展示的 <goal_chip>。
description.en: This zone holds face-up displayed <goal_chip>s.

description.zh: <progress_board> 上的 <ontology::market>，正面朝上展示可拿取的 <income_chip>。设置时从白色袋子随机抽取 1 张放到每个格。固定 3 格，与玩家人数无关。
description.en: A <ontology::market> on the <progress_board> displaying available <income_chip>s face up. During setup, 1 chip is randomly drawn from the white bag onto each space. Fixed at 3 spaces regardless of player count.

description.zh: 此区域存放正面朝上展示的 <income_chip>。
description.en: This zone holds face-up displayed <income_chip>s.

description.zh: <progress_board> 上的 <ontology::market>，正面朝上展示可拿取的 <attribute_chip>。
description.en: A <ontology::market> on the <progress_board> displaying available <attribute_chip>s face up. A number of attribute chips are randomly drawn and placed here during setup.

description.zh: 此区域存放正面朝上展示的 <attribute_chip>。
description.en: This zone holds face-up displayed <attribute_chip>s.

description.en: A track on the <sequence_board> recording the current Favor of Agera level. It affects the success range of <favor_test>s, statue income, and final scoring.

description.zh: 此轨存放阿格拉恩惠标记。

description.zh: 位于 <sequence_board> 上的轨，记录当前天气。共 7 格，从热端到冷端依次为：白线外热端（<hot_beyond>）、炎热、温暖、适中（起始位）、雨水、寒冷、白线外冷端（<cold_beyond>）。白线位于 <hot_beyond> 与 <hot> 之间、<cold_beyond> 与 <cold> 之间——白线内 5 格为正常天气格，白线外两端各 1 格为越线格。当 <weather_indicator> 移动越出白线（落在 <hot_beyond> 或 <cold_beyond>），结算该越线格的效果——移除 1 个 <tribe>，随后将标记推回白线内的极端格（<hot> 或 <cold>）。由 <weather_effect> 触发结算。
description.en: A track on the <sequence_board> recording the current weather. 7 slots from hot to cold: <hot_beyond> (beyond the hot white line), Hot, Warm, Mild (starting space), Rain, Cold, <cold_beyond> (beyond the cold white line). The white lines lie between <hot_beyond> and <hot>, and between <cold_beyond> and <cold> — the 5 inner slots are the normal weather spaces, the 2 outer slots are over-line spaces. When the <weather_indicator> moves over a white line (landing on <hot_beyond> or <cold_beyond>), the over-line slot's effect is resolved — remove 1 <tribe> — and the indicator is then pushed back onto the extreme space inside the line (<hot> or <cold>). Resolution is triggered by <weather_effect>.

description.en: This track holds the weather indicator.

description.zh: 位于 <sequence_board> 上的轨，记录当前阶段。阶段标记沿黄色箭头移动，指示 8 个阶段中的当前阶段。行动阶段中阶段标记推进的 reset space 部分带人数标记：带 3 人标记的 reset space 在玩家人数 ≥3 时使用，带 4 人标记的仅在 4 人局使用——2/3 人局中带标记的 reset space 在设置时被阻挡标记覆盖。
description.en: A track on the <sequence_board> recording the current phase. The phase indicator moves along the yellow arrow to show the current of the 8 phases. Some reset spaces the phase indicator advances through during the Action phase bear player-count marks: reset spaces marked with a 3 are used in games of 3+ players, those marked with a 4 only in 4-player games — marked reset spaces are covered with blocking tokens in 2/3-player games.

description.zh: 此轨存放阶段标记。
description.en: This track holds the phase indicator.

description.zh: 黄色重置格——重置 A 步每次将<phase_indicator>推 1 格；有效格数随人数变化（2/3/4 人局 5/7/9 格），带人数标记的格在低人数局被阻挡标记覆盖（见<reset_space>定义）。
description.en: Yellow reset spaces — Reset step A advances the <phase_indicator> one space each time; the number in use varies by player count (5/7/9 for 2/3/4 players), with player-count-marked spaces covered by blocking tokens in lower-count games (see the <reset_space> definition).

description.zh: 红色重置结束格——重置不再推它；<action_phase_end> 触发（触发轮与下一轮结束后）自动推入阶段五。
description.en: The red reset end space — Reset no longer advances it; after <action_phase_end> holds (the triggering round and the following round complete), it is auto-advanced into Phase 5.

description.zh: <phase_sequence> 上第四阶段与第五阶段之间的行动阶段轨段中的黄色格。阶段标记被 Reset 的 A 步沿黄色箭头逐格推进。轨段长度随人数变化（2 人 5 格、3 人 7 格、4 人 9 格）——部分格带人数标记：带 3 标记的格在 3 人及以上局使用，带 4 标记的格仅在 4 人局使用，其余在 setup 时被一百分指示物背面（阻挡标记）覆盖。
description.en: A yellow space in the Action phase track segment of <phase_sequence>, between Phase 4 and Phase 5. The phase indicator advances along the yellow arrow one space per Reset step A. The segment length varies by player count (5 spaces for 2 players, 7 for 3, 9 for 4) — some spaces bear player-count marks: spaces marked 3 are used in games of 3+ players, spaces marked 4 only in 4-player games; the rest are covered with blocking tokens (backs of 100-point tokens) during setup.

description.zh: <phase_sequence> 行动阶段轨段末端唯一的红色格。阶段标记被 Reset 的 A 步推至此格时，<action_phase_end> 条件成立，触发行动阶段结束（先完成当前行动轮，再进行最终行动轮，之后推入阶段五）。
description.en: The single red space at the end of the Action phase track segment of <phase_sequence>. When the phase indicator is pushed here by Reset step A, the <action_phase_end> condition holds and the Action phase ends (complete the current round, play the final action round, then advance to Phase 5).

description.zh: <sequence_board> 上用于放置本时代计分 <scoring_tile> 的区域。时代计分阶段按图标类别结算。
description.en: An area on the <sequence_board> for placing the era <scoring_tile>s. Resolved during the Era Scoring phase by icon category.

description.zh: 此区域存放本时代计分 <scoring_tile>。
description.en: This zone holds era <scoring_tile>s.

description.zh: 终局计分区中的图标格位 <ontology::zone>，每格印有一种计分类别图标，格下方印有该类别默认分值。设置时随机抽取 3 张 <scoring_tile>，按图标匹配放到对应格下方——<ontology::replaces> 该格印的默认分值（终局计分时取板块上的分数）；未被覆盖的格用印的分值。
description.en: Icon slots within the final scoring area — a <ontology::zone>, each slot printed with a scoring category icon and a default point value below it. During setup, 3 randomly drawn <scoring_tile>s are placed below their matching icon slots — <ontology::replaces> the printed default value of that space (the tile's points apply at final scoring); spaces not covered keep their printed value.

description.zh: 每个图标格都可以放置图标匹配的 <scoring_tile>（分数面朝上）。
description.en: Each icon slot can hold a <scoring_tile> matching its icon (point side up).

description.zh: 终局计分区中的六角格 <ontology::track>，每格对应终局计分区（图标）中的一个图标格。游戏结束时，将阶段标记从阶段流程移至此轨，一格一格向右推进——每推进一格，按该格对应图标上的 <scoring_tile> 类别结算分数。
description.en: A hexagonal-cell <ontology::track> within the final scoring area. Each cell corresponds to one icon slot in the Final Scoring Area (Icons). At game end, the phase indicator is moved from the phase sequence onto this track, advancing cell by cell to the right — each cell triggers scoring based on the category of the <scoring_tile> on the corresponding icon.

description.zh: 终局计分时，阶段标记移至此轨作为计分标记逐格推进。
description.en: During final scoring, the phase indicator is moved here and advances cell by cell as the scoring marker.

description.zh: 声望计分格。

description.zh: 格 A：结算控制台阶段分区——每个阶段中的卡牌和芯片按该阶段左侧印的分数计分（阶段 4/5 需对应 stage tile 激活）。
description.en: Space A: score the console stage partition — each chip and card scores the points left of its stage (stages 4/5 only if the stage tile is active).

description.zh: 格 B：结算 point bonus 卡——每张带加成图标的卡牌为其所在列的所有卡牌和收入芯片（含自身）额外加分。
description.en: Space B: score point bonus cards — each card with the bonus icon grants extra points for all cards and income chips in its column (itself included).

description.zh: 位于 <progress_board> 上的 <ontology::zone>，由两部分组成——终局计分区（图标）用于放置 <scoring_tile>，终局计分区（六角格）用于终局计分时逐格推进标记。设置时随机抽取 <scoring_tile> 分数面朝上放置在匹配的图标格上。游戏结束时，将阶段标记从 <phase_sequence> 移至六角格中，一格一格向右推进——每移一格，按该格对应图标的 <scoring_tile> 类别结算分数。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on the <progress_board> consisting of two parts — the Final Scoring Area (Icons) for placing <scoring_tile>s, and the Final Scoring Area (Hex Grid) for advancing the marker cell by cell during final scoring. During setup, randomly drawn <scoring_tile>s are placed point-side up on the matching icon slots. At game end, the phase indicator is moved from the <phase_sequence> onto the hex grid, advancing cell by cell to the right — scoring the category of the <scoring_tile> on the corresponding icon for each cell reached.

description.zh: 每位玩家的<console>，包含模组区、目标列、属性列、收入区、仓库、特征格、创意格、骰子区等。
description.en: Each player's <console> containing the module area, goal column, attribute column, income area, storage, feature spaces, idea spaces, and dice area.

position.en: right half of the <console>, below <module_area>, above <feature_space>
top-left of the <console>

position.zh: 面板左半边，目标区右边，钱币格上方
position.en: left half, right of goal area, above money space

position.zh: 面板左半边，目标区右边，食物格下方
position.en: left half, right of goal area, below food space
right of money space

description.zh: 交易规则速查：各材料行换钱币的数量（钱袋图标）及各材料购买价格。详见 <trade>。
description.en: Trade reference: money per material row (money bag icons) and purchase prices. See <trade>.

position.zh: 面板左半边，仓库上方，钱币格下方
position.en: left half of the <console>, above storage, below money space

position.zh: 面板左半边，仓库左边，船供应堆上方
position.en: left half of the <console>, left of storage, above boat supply

position.zh: 面板左半边，仓库左边，农场供应堆下方
position.en: left half of the <console>, left of storage, below farm supply

position.zh: 面板左半边，目标区下方，仓库左侧，农场和船供应堆周围
position.en: left half of the <console>, below goal area, left of storage, around farm and boat supplies

description.zh: 建造项目提示。列出四种可建造项目及其概况：<farm>（无费用，得创意标记，最多 3 个）、<boat>（无费用，登船奖励，最多 2 艘）、<statue>（付一种材料，可选推进程轨，收入阶段计分）、<settlement>（付材料，得收入芯片，最多 4 个）。详见 <complete_building_project>。
description.en: Building project reference. Lists the four buildable projects: <farm> (no cost, gain idea marker, max 3), <boat> (no cost, boarding reward, max 2), <statue> (pay one material, may push progress track, scores in Income phase), <settlement> (pay materials, gain income chip, max 4). See <complete_building_project>.

position.zh: 面板左半边，仓库右边，<idea_space>上方
position.en: left half of the <console>, right of storage, above <idea_space>

position.zh: 面板左半边，仓库右边，<focus_space>下方
position.en: left half of the <console>, right of storage, below <focus_space>

position.zh: 面板右半边，模组区下方，激活骰子区下方
position.en: right half of the <console>, below <module_area>, below <activation_dice_area>
left of stages 1/2/3
right of tier 1
right of tier 2

position.zh: 面板右半边，焦点格右侧
position.en: right half of the <console>, right of <focus_space>

description.zh: <console> 上放置 <module> 的区域，有固定的 22 个槽位。主模组可升级，睡眠模组和特征模组固定不变。
description.en: The area on the <console> where <module>s are placed, with 22 fixed slots. Main modules can be upgraded; sleep and feature modules are fixed.

description.zh: <console> 右半边放置 <activation_die> 的区域，位于 <module_area> 下方、<feature_space> 上方。分为 6 格，分别对应骰子点数 1 至 6——每颗激活骰子掷出后放在与点数匹配的格上。激活模组时从此区取用骰子；Reset 的 B 步回收所有已使用的激活骰子重掷并放回。控制台外另有 <fate_dice_area> 和 <planning_marker> 的放置位。
description.en: The area on the right half of the <console> for <activation_die>s, located below the <module_area> and above the <feature_space>. Divided into 6 spaces, one per die value 1 through 6 — each rolled activation die is placed on the matching space. Dice are taken from this area to activate modules; Reset step B retrieves all used activation dice, re-rolls them, and returns them here. Outside the console, there are separate spots for the <fate_dice_area> and <planning_marker>.

description.zh: 位于 <console> 旁边（不在面板上），放置玩家的 <fate_die>。设置阶段从游戏盒中拿取 1 个粉骰子放在此处。恩惠检定时投掷此骰子，根据 <favor_of_ager_track> 当前位置判定是否通过。
description.en: Located beside the <console> (not on the board), holding the player's <fate_die>. During setup, take 1 fate die from the game box and place it here. Roll this die for favor tests; the result is checked against the current position on the <favor_of_ager_track>.

description.zh: <console> 左半边放置 <idea_marker> 的格子。上限 12 个，超过不丢弃但无法继续获得。
description.en: A space on the left half of the <console> for holding <idea_marker>s. Capacity is 12; excess markers cannot be gained but are not discarded.

description.zh: <console> 左半边、<idea_space> 上方的格子，用于放置 <focus_marker>。容量 1 个。
description.en: A space on the left half of the <console>, above <idea_space>, for holding a <focus_marker>. Capacity is 1.

description.zh: <console> 右半边放置 <feature_marker> 的区域，位于 <module_area> 下方、<activation_dice_area> 下方。共 6 格，从左到右分别对应耐力（Stamina）、智慧（Intelligence）、镇定（Calm）、灵巧（Dexterity）、表达（Expression）、观察（Perception）六种特征。
description.en: The area on the right half of the <console> for <feature_marker>s, located below the <module_area> and below the <activation_dice_area>. 6 slots, left to right: Stamina, Intelligence, Calm, Dexterity, Expression, Perception.

description.zh: 印于<console>层级 1 右侧。当层级 1 所有安装位被填满时触发：执行一次<gain_income_chip>。
description.en: Printed to the right of tier 1 on the <console>. Triggers when all installation slots in tier 1 are filled: perform <gain_income_chip> once.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 层级 1 所有安装位被填满
<ontology::condition>.en: All installation slots in tier 1 are filled

description.zh: 印于<console>层级 2 右侧。当层级 2 所有安装位被填满时触发：选择一个未激活的<stage_tile>翻至激活面。
description.en: Printed to the right of tier 2 on the <console>. Triggers when all installation slots in tier 2 are filled: choose an inactive <stage_tile> and flip it to its active face.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 层级 2 所有安装位被填满
<ontology::condition>.en: All installation slots in tier 2 are filled

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <research_card>、<income_chip>、<goal_chip>、<attribute_chip> 的大片网格区域。由横向的 <tier>（层级）和纵向的 <column>（列）交叉构成安装位，每个安装位可放置一张研究牌或一枚芯片。最左侧一列被层级 4 板块和层级 5 板块占据——这两个板块纵向延展，从层级 6 开始挡住该列使其不可用于安装。阶段 4 和阶段 5 初始未激活，需通过建造第 4 个聚落激活。
description.en: The large grid area on the <console> for installing <research_card>s, <income_chip>s, <goal_chip>s, and <attribute_chip>s. Composed of horizontal <tier>s and vertical <column>s intersecting to form installation slots — each slot holds one research card or one chip. The leftmost column is occupied by the Stage-4 and Stage-5 tiles, which extend vertically and block that column for installation from tier 6 onward. Stages 4 and 5 start inactive and are unlocked by building the 4th settlement.

description.zh: <console> 层级分区中的一行安装位。从下往上编号，层级 1（最底部）有 4 个 <column> 可用，层级 2 有 6 个，层级 3 有 8 个，层级 4 及以上每层均有 9 个可用。一层的高度等于 <research_card> 长度的三分之一（安装后仅露出上部能力区），也等于 <income_chip> 或 <attribute_chip> 的短边长，或 <goal_chip> 的边长。层级向上无限延伸，但研究牌和芯片只能安装在已有的空闲安装位上——每个 <column> 内必须从低层级往高层级连续安装，不可跳过空位。层级 6 及以上，最左侧一列因被层级 4/5 板块挡住不可用。
description.en: A horizontal row of installation slots in the <console> tier grid. Numbered bottom-up: tier 1 (lowest) has 4 usable <column>s, tier 2 has 6, tier 3 has 8, and tier 4 and above each have 9 usable slots. One tier's height equals one-third of a <research_card>'s length (when installed, only the top ability section is exposed), and also equals the short edge of an <income_chip> or <attribute_chip>, or the edge length of a <goal_chip>. Tiers extend infinitely upward, but research cards and chips can only be installed in existing empty slots — within each <column>, installation must proceed from lower tiers upward without skipping. At tier 6 and above, the leftmost column is blocked by Stage-4/Stage-5 tiles.

description.zh: <console> 层级分区中的一列安装位，从底部贯穿至顶部。一列的宽度等于一张 <research_card> 的宽度，或一枚 <income_chip>、一枚 <attribute_chip>、两枚 <goal_chip> 的宽度。层级分区共有 10 个纵向列位，其中最左侧一列被层级 4 和层级 5 板块占据（不可用于安装研究牌或芯片），其余 9 列供研究牌和芯片安装。<goal_chip> 安装在最左侧可用列，<attribute_chip> 安装在目标列旁，<income_chip> 可安装在任意列。<research_card> 必须与该列此前安装的研究牌同色（同一研究领域）。每列内的安装必须从低层级开始连续向上，不可跳空。
description.en: A vertical column of installation slots in the <console> tier grid, running from bottom to top. One column's width equals the width of one <research_card>, or one <income_chip>, one <attribute_chip>, or two <goal_chip>s. The tier grid has 10 column positions total; the leftmost is occupied by Stage-4 and Stage-5 tiles (unavailable for cards or chips), leaving 9 columns for cards and chips. <goal_chip>s are installed in the leftmost available column, <attribute_chip>s next to the goal column, and <income_chip>s in any column. <research_card>s in a column must share the same color (research domain). Each column must be filled from lower tiers upward without gaps.

description.zh: <console> 上存放<stored_material>的<ontology::player_holding>。按 3 行 × 6 列排列，共 18 格，每列对应一种领地类型，每行对应稀有度（行 1 基础、行 2 稀有、行 3 珍贵）。同一格同类材料堆叠放置。行 1 与行 2 之间每列印有 1 颗钻石，行 2 与行 3 之间每列印有 2 颗钻石——Prosperity 计分时，上下两格均非空则该列对应钻石计为活跃。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <stored_material>s. Arranged in 3 rows × 6 columns = 18 spaces; each column maps to one territory type, each row to a rarity tier (row 1 basic, row 2 rare, row 3 precious). Same-type materials stack in one space. 1 diamond is printed between rows 1-2 per column, 2 diamonds between rows 2-3 per column — during Prosperity scoring, a column's diamonds count as active if both adjacent spaces are non-empty.

description.zh: 行 1 与行 2 之间：每列 1 颗钻石。行 2 与行 3 之间：每列 2 颗钻石。上下相邻两格均非空时该列钻石激活。
description.en: Between rows 1-2: 1 diamond per column. Between rows 2-3: 2 diamonds per column. A column's diamonds activate when both adjacent spaces are non-empty.

description.zh: <console> 左上方用于存放 <goal_chip> 的 <ontology::player_holding>。共 3 格，每格可堆叠任意数量。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the top-left of the <console> for holding <goal_chip>s. 3 slots, each holding an unlimited stack.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 此格最后一枚 <goal_chip> 被安装后
<ontology::condition>.en: After the last <goal_chip> in this slot is installed

description.zh: <console> 模组槽底部的<ontology::player_zone>，共 15 格，一一对应 15 个主模组。每格可放置对应模组的<ontology::tile>，并带一个<ontology::continuous_effect>——condition 为对应模组升至 3 级时激活其 L3 效果。与<goal_area>类似：格状态变化触发效果。
description.en: A <ontology::player_zone> at the bottom of module slots on the <console>, with 15 slots, one per main module. Each slot can hold the corresponding <ontology::tile> and carries a <ontology::continuous_effect> — when the corresponding module reaches level 3, its L3 effect is activated. Similar to <goal_area>: slot state change triggers the effect.

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 激活该模组的 L3 效果

description.zh: <console> 上放置<farm>的<ontology::player_holding>，共 3 格，每格初始放置 1 个<farm>。建造时拿取，不补充。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <farm>s, with 3 slots, each initially holding 1 <farm>. Taken when building; not replenished.

description.zh: <console> 上放置<boat>的<ontology::player_holding>，共 2 格，每格初始放置 1 个<boat>。建造时拿取，不补充。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <boat>s, with 2 slots, each initially holding 1 <boat>. Taken when building; not replenished.

description.zh: <console> 上放置<settlement>的<ontology::player_holding>，共 4 格，每格初始放置 1 个<settlement>。建造时拿取对应格的<settlement>放至<continent>的建造点，不补充。每格下方印有钻石——<settlement>被移走后露出，数量因格而异（1、2 或 3 颗）。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <settlement>s, with 4 slots, each initially holding 1 <settlement>. When building, take the <settlement> from its slot and place it on a Building ground on the <continent>; not replenished. Diamonds are printed under each slot — revealed when the <settlement> is removed, in varying numbers per slot (1, 2, or 3).

description.zh: 每格左侧印有建造该聚落需支付的材料清单，因格而异。
description.en: The material list required to build each settlement is printed to the left of its slot; varies by slot.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 事件阶段 Prosperity（繁荣）计分时
<ontology::condition>.en: During Prosperity scoring in the Event phase

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 露出的钻石计入活跃钻石总数，乘以 Prosperity 分类倍率获得分数。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: Visible diamonds count toward active diamond total; multiplied by Prosperity category multiplier for points.

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <goal_chip> 的列。<goal_chip> 宽度为 <column> 的一半，同一 <tier> 左右半侧各可装一枚。每完成一叠目标芯片可升级一个主模组。
description.en: The column on the <console> for installing <goal_chip>s. <goal_chip>s are half the column width; each <tier> fits one per side (left and right). Completing a stack of goal chips allows upgrading one main module.

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <attribute_chip> 的列。属性芯片一旦安装即提供持续效果。
description.en: The column on the <console> for installing <attribute_chip>s. Installed attribute chips provide continuous effects.

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <income_chip> 的区域。收入阶段从上到下、从左到右依次执行。
description.en: The area on the <console> for installing <income_chip>s. Income chips execute top-to-bottom, left-to-right during the Income phase.

description.zh: <console> 上存放食物标记的格子，位于控制台左侧、<goal_area> 右边，<money_space> 上方。狩猎、收入芯片和某些效果可获得食物标记。喂养阶段从此格支付食物。食物标记按每 3 个一列排列，每完整列在 Prosperity 计分时算 1 个活跃钻石。
description.en: A space on the <console> for holding food markers, located on the left half of the console, to the right of <goal_area>, above <money_space>. Food markers are gained through hunting, income chips, and certain effects. Food is paid from this space during the Feeding phase. Food markers are arranged in columns of 3; each complete column counts as 1 active diamond for Prosperity scoring.

description.zh: <console> 上存放钱币标记的格子，位于控制台左侧、<goal_area> 右边，<food_space> 下方。通过交易模组出售材料获得。钱币标记按每 2 个一列排列，每完整列在 Prosperity 计分时算 1 个活跃钻石。
description.en: A space on the <console> for holding money markers, located on the left half of the console, to the right of <goal_area>, below <food_space>. Money is gained by selling materials via the Trade module. Money markers are arranged in columns of 2; each complete column counts as 1 active diamond for Prosperity scoring.

description.zh: <console> 右半边的 4 列重置轨道，位于 <focus_space> 右侧。每列顶部初始放置 1 个 <reset_marker>。执行 <reset> 时，将最靠左的标记沿列逐步下推——A→B→C 三步，C 步完成后标记离开重置列进入 <idea_space> 或 <food_space>。重置列为空的数量标志着<phase_indicator>已被推进的次数。收入阶段结束时，空列从供应堆重新补满 <reset_marker>。
description.en: 4 reset columns on the right half of the <console>, to the right of <focus_space>. Each column starts with 1 <reset_marker> at the top. When performing <reset>, the leftmost marker is pushed down its column step by step — A→B→C, after which the marker leaves the column for <idea_space> or <food_space>. The number of empty columns tracks how many times the <phase_indicator> has been advanced. At the end of the Income phase, empty columns are refilled with <reset_marker>s from supply.

position.en: left of reset columns

description.zh: A: 推动阶段标记至下一个 reset space（到达红色格触发行动阶段结束）。B: 回收所有已使用的激活骰子重掷并放回。C: 重置标记移至创意格或食物格。
description.en: A: Advance phase indicator to next reset space (red space triggers Action Phase end). B: Retrieve all used activation dice, re-roll and return. C: Move reset marker to idea space or food space.

description.zh: 放置在 <reset_column> 中的标记。每位玩家初始有 4 个，Setup 时放在 4 个重置列顶部。执行 Reset 时沿列步进，完成 C 步后移入 idea space 或 food space。收入阶段结束时，所有空的重置列重新从供应堆补满。注意：重置标记不能从<console>召回以补充供应堆上限（与其他标记不同）。
description.en: A marker placed in a <reset_column>. Each player starts with 4, placed at the top of the 4 reset columns during Setup. Steps down the column during a Reset; after step C, moves to the idea space or food space. At the end of the Income phase, all empty reset columns are refilled from supply. Note: reset markers cannot be recalled from the <console> to replenish the supply limit (unlike other markers).

description.zh: 公共版图旁用于摆放 10 个研究牌堆的区域，由 5 个 <research_deck>（背面朝下牌堆）和 5 个 <face_up_research_stack>（正面朝上牌堆）组成。每时代阶段一从每个背面朝下牌堆顶翻一张到对应的正面朝上牌堆（第一时代新建堆，后续时代覆盖）。玩家可通过 Research 模组从正面或背面牌堆顶拿取卡牌。当正面朝上牌堆被拿空时，立即从对应背面朝下牌堆翻一张补充。
description.en: The area beside the game boards for the 10 research stacks: 5 <research_deck>s (face-down) and 5 <face_up_research_stack>s (face-up). Each era in Phase 1, reveal the top card from each face-down stack onto the corresponding face-up stack (forming a new stack in era 1, covering the previous card thereafter). Players can take the top card from either stack type via the Research module. When a face-up stack empties, immediately reveal the top card from the corresponding face-down stack.

description.zh: 每种研究牌类型各有一个的正面朝上牌堆，展示该类型当前可被直接拿取的 <research_card>。与对应的 <research_deck> 配对——当此堆被拿空时，立即从对应背面朝下堆翻一张补充。
description.en: One per research card type, a face-up stack showing the currently available <research_card> of that type. Paired with the corresponding <research_deck> — when this stack empties, immediately reveal the top card from the face-down stack.

description.zh: <sequence_board> 上用于放置 <event_card> 的 <ontology::zone>，分左右两格：右边一格放置背面朝上的事件牌堆，供每时代抽取；左边一格放置正面朝上的事件牌堆，其中最上面的 <event_card> 的效果将于当前时代的事件阶段被触发。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on the <sequence_board> for <event_card>s, split into two slots: the right slot holds a face-down event card stack for drawing each era; the left slot holds a face-up event card stack, whose topmost <event_card>'s effect is triggered during this era's Event phase.

description.zh: 此区域存放 <event_card>：右格背面朝上堆叠，左格正面朝上展示当前时代那张。
description.en: This zone holds <event_card>s: the right slot stacked face down, the left slot showing the current era's card face up.

objects.<ontology::information_visibility>: 左边一格为public，右边一格为hidden

description.zh: 5 个背面朝下的研究牌堆，按卡牌类型区分（建造/洞悉/突变/成就/发明），每堆 32 张。Setup 时分别洗混，与 5 个 <face_up_research_stack> 一一配对。每时代阶段一翻一张到对应正面堆；被拿空后继续从背面翻。
description.en: 5 face-down research stacks, one per card type (Building/Insight/Mutation/Achievement/Invention), 32 cards each. Shuffled separately during setup. Each is paired with a <face_up_research_stack>. Phase 1 reveals the top card to the face-up stack each era; when the face-up stack empties, reveal the next card from here.

description.zh: 放置 <starting_marker_card> 的牌堆。设置后不再使用。
description.en: The deck holding <starting_marker_card>s. Not used after setup.

description.zh: 放置 <starting_chip_card> 的牌堆。设置后作为第一个收入芯片塞入<console>。
description.en: The deck holding <starting_chip_card>s. After setup, it becomes the first income chip slid under the <console>.

description.zh: 《文明演化》纸质规则书，用于查询详细规则。
description.en: The printed rulebook for Civolution, used for detailed rule lookups.

description.zh: 帮助玩家理解阶段顺序和图标含义的辅助卡。
description.en: A card helping players understand phase order and icon meanings.

description.zh: 每个时代的第一个 <ontology::phase>。翻开事件牌堆顶一张（覆盖上时代事件牌），显示本时代天气变化方向和事件效果；然后翻开 5 个背面朝下研究牌堆各顶部一张，放到对应的正面朝上研究牌堆上。
description.en: The first <ontology::phase> of each era. Reveal the top event card (covering the previous era's), showing this era's weather change and event effect; then reveal the top card from each of the 5 face-down research decks onto the corresponding face-up stacks.

description.zh: 每个时代的第二个 <ontology::phase>。从起始玩家开始顺时针，每位玩家可选择从 <goal_chip_display> 拿取一枚 <goal_chip> 安装到 <goal_column>，或跳过；随后补满展示区空位。
description.en: The second <ontology::phase> of each era. Starting with the start player clockwise, each player may take a <goal_chip> from the <goal_chip_display> into their <goal_column>, or pass; then refill empty display spaces.

description.zh: 每个时代的第三个 <ontology::phase>。从起始玩家开始顺时针，每位玩家选择一个有自己 <tribe> 的大陆区域，从该区域可产出的材料中选一种获得一个 <raw_material>，放置到对应位置。
description.en: The third <ontology::phase> of each era. Starting with the start player clockwise, each player chooses a <territory> containing their <tribe>, selects one of the materials it produces, and gains a <raw_material>.

description.zh: 每个时代的主要 <ontology::phase>。玩家顺时针轮流行动，每回合必须二选一：激活一个 <module>（支付恰好 2 个对应点数的 <activation_die>，或用 <planning_marker>/<focus_marker> 替代）或执行 Reset（前提：骰子区剩余 ≤3 个 <activation_die>）。阶段标记沿 <phase_sequence> 的黄色箭头逐步推进，到达红色格后触发行动阶段结束。
description.en: The main <ontology::phase> of each era. Players take turns clockwise; each turn must either activate a <module> (pay exactly 2 <activation_die>s of matching values, or use <planning_marker>/<focus_marker>) or perform a Reset (only if ≤3 <activation_die>s remain on dice spaces). The phase indicator advances along the <phase_sequence>'s yellow arrow; reaching the red space triggers the end of the Action phase.

description.zh: 每个时代的第五个 <ontology::phase>。结算 <continent> 上已翻开的 <site> 效果。
description.en: The fifth <ontology::phase> of each era. Resolve effects of revealed <site>s on the <continent>.

description.zh: 每个时代的第六个 <ontology::phase>。玩家从 <food_space> 支付 <food> 喂养 <tribe>：营地/船上的部落各需 1 个，野外部落各需 2 个。未喂饱的部落死亡，放回供应堆。之后所有站立部落得 1 分。
description.en: The sixth <ontology::phase> of each era. Players pay <food> from their <food_space> to feed <tribe>s: 1 each for tribes on encampments/boats, 2 each for tribes in the wilderness. Unfed tribes die and return to supply. Then each standing tribe scores 1 point.

description.zh: 每个时代的第七个 <ontology::phase>。依次执行：结算天气效果、结算 <event_card> 效果、时代计分（按 <era_scoring_area> 中 <scoring_tile> 类别）、确定新的起始玩家（刚在该计分类别中得分最高者）。
description.en: The seventh <ontology::phase> of each era. Execute in order: resolve weather effect, resolve <event_card> effect, era scoring (by <scoring_tile>s in the <era_scoring_area>), determine new starting player (highest scorer of that category).

description.zh: 每个时代的第八个 <ontology::phase>。依次执行：A) 获得收入——每位玩家对每个已安装 <income_chip> 各执行一次 <activate_income_chip>（顺序自选，可同时进行，少数按座次）；B) 结算 <statue> 收入——每座雕像得 <favor_of_ager_track> 圆盘上方印的分数；C) 回收 <continent> 上所有 <hunting_token> 至 <hunting_token_display>；D) 每位玩家从供应堆补满空 <reset_column>。收尾：前三时代将 <phase_indicator> 移回阶段一；第四时代（<era_scoring_area> 全空）跳过 C/D，将 <phase_indicator> 放到终局计分轨最左格进入终局计分。
description.en: The eighth <ontology::phase> of each era. Execute in order: A) gain income — each player performs <activate_income_chip> once per installed <income_chip> (order of choice, may be simultaneous, a few cases in seating order); B) score <statue>s — each statue gains the points printed above your disc on the <favor_of_ager_track>; C) return all <hunting_token>s from the <continent> to the <hunting_token_display>; D) each player refills empty <reset_column>s from supply. Ending: eras 1-3 return the <phase_indicator> to Phase 1; the 4th era (era scoring area empty) skips C/D and places the <phase_indicator> on the leftmost final-scoring hexagon, entering final scoring.

description.zh: 一种 <ontology::effect>。
description.en: A type of <ontology::effect>.

description.zh: Civolution 玩家保留区通用引用，主要指玩家手牌中的研究牌。
description.en: Generic player holding reference in Civolution, mainly referring to research cards in hand.
